content.value_statement: Generic search content often misses Belgian language, location, and regional context. This guide helps agents draft localized pages, FAQs, structured data, and content plans.
actual_capabilities: Guides drafting of service-and-municipality landing pages for Belgian businesses.
Guides creation of concise FAQ answers intended for search and AI answer engines.
Provides a LocalBusiness JSON-LD example and guidance for FAQPage and breadcrumb structured data.
Supports planning six-month organic content calendars combining local pages and informational content.
Directs attention to Dutch and French audiences and regional differences across Flanders, Brussels, and Wallonia.
Suggests incorporating Belgian subsidy information, subject to manual verification.
limitations: Only a public Markdown guide is included; scripts, extension source, and the advertised template library are absent.
Subsidy amounts, eligibility rules, and update claims require independent verification against current official sources.
Generated drafts cannot guarantee search rankings, AI citations, structured data validity, or regulatory compliance.
The guidance focuses on Belgian organic content in Dutch and French, not paid advertising.

use_cases.title: Prepare Local Service Pages
use_cases.description: Draft municipality-specific service pages using verified business details and locally relevant questions.

use_cases.title: Plan Regional Client Content
use_cases.description: Build six-month editorial plans across municipalities and regions without repeating generic location copy.

use_cases.title: Write Clear Regional FAQs
use_cases.description: Create Dutch or French FAQ drafts using supplied official subsidy sources and clearly identified information gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a First Local Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Dutch service page for [business] offering [service] in [municipality]. Use only these verified facts: [facts]. Mark missing details.

prompt_templates.title: Create Answer-Focused FAQs
prompt_templates.prompt: Write five concise French FAQs for [service] in [municipality]. Base answers on [verified facts]. Do not invent prices, qualifications, or subsidy eligibility.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare focused answers for a service page.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Structured Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft LocalBusiness and FAQPage JSON-LD for [page]. Use [verified business details] and only FAQs visible on the page. List missing fields for validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: prepare structured data for technical review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Regional Organic Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan six months of Dutch and French content for [business] across [municipalities]. Include local pages, informational topics, internal links, and official subsidy sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate a regional content program with source verification.

output_examples.input: Draft an outline for a heat pump installer serving Ghent without supplying subsidy amounts.
output: Page title: Heat Pump Installation in Ghent | [Business Name]
Sections: Services, property assessment, installation process, verified service area, and customer questions.
FAQ: Which subsidies may apply? Eligibility and amounts require confirmation from current official Flemish sources.
Review needed: Business identity, qualifications, contact details, and supported product types.

output_examples.input: Suggest the first three months of a six-month organic plan for a Belgian insulation company.
output: Month 1: Draft a service overview and one municipality page using verified local project details.
Month 2: Prepare a regional subsidy explainer after confirming current official eligibility rules.
Month 3: Publish a customer FAQ and link it to the relevant service and location pages.
Review each draft for language accuracy, regional relevance, and unsupported business claims.

best_practices: Verify subsidy amounts and eligibility against current official regional sources before publication.
Provide accurate business details, target municipalities, and the intended Dutch or French audience.
Review generated copy and validate structured data against the actual visible page content.
anti_patterns: Publishing the sample subsidy amount or eligibility rules without current source verification.
Creating near-identical municipality pages with invented local experience or unsupported business details.
Assuming the public guide includes scripts, premium templates, guaranteed rankings, or guaranteed AI citations.

faq.question: What does this skill include?
faq.answer: It includes a public Markdown guide with Belgian content guidance and a brief example. Scripts, extension source, and premium templates are not included.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this guide?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Results depend on the assistant and the business information you provide.

faq.question: Does it provide verified current subsidy information?
faq.answer: No live verification mechanism is included. Confirm all amounts, eligibility rules, and dates with official regional sources before publication.

faq.question: Which languages and regions does it address?
faq.answer: The guide focuses on Dutch and French content for Belgian businesses, including regional differences across Flanders, Brussels, and Wallonia.

faq.question: Does it guarantee rankings or AI citations?
faq.answer: No. It provides drafting guidance for local search and answer-focused content, without guarantees about rankings, citations, traffic, or leads.

faq.question: Can it publish pages or validate structured data automatically?
faq.answer: No publishing integration or validation tool is included. Review generated pages and validate structured data separately before deployment.
